title: Cost of a Goldreich–Levin stage
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer, let $a,b$ be positive integers with $2a\le b$, and let $M\ge1$ be an integer Fourier norm bound. For a Boolean target $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, a stage index $k<n$, and a finite active family of coordinate subsets, running the deterministic Goldreich–Levin stage with oracle $f$ returns its prescribed list of estimate records and has exactly the prescribed stage cost: one batch of restricted-weight queries together with the stage’s charged local work.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean target on the sign cube
Finite active family of coordinate subsets
